privateVars.name: prisma
privateVars.description: Prisma database service for notification CRUD operations

privateVars.name: gateway
privateVars.description: WebSocket gateway used to push real-time notifications to users

functions.name: findAll
functions.description: Finds all notifications for a user with optional pagination, type, and status filtering

functions.name: create

params.name: data
params.type: { title: string; message: string; type: NotificationType; metadata?: DeviceApprovalMetadata }

functions.description: Creates a new PENDING notification, persists it, and pushes it to the user via WebSocket

functions.name: updateStatus
functions.description: Updates the status of a notification and pushes the update to the user via WebSocket

functions.name: approveDeviceRequest
functions.description: Approves a device linking request: validates notification, updates device with encrypted master key, marks notification as APPROVED

exceptions.name: rrBadRequestException
exceptions.message: Only interactive notifications can be approved

exceptions.name: rrBadRequestException
exceptions.message: Notification metadata is missing device linking details

functions.name: delete
functions.description: Deletes a single notification by ID for a user and pushes the deletion event via WebSocket

functions.name: deleteAll
functions.description: Deletes all notifications for a user and pushes the cleared event via WebSocket

functions.name: deleteOldNotifications
functions.description: Cron job that runs daily at midnight to delete notifications older than one week

functions.name: mapToDto
functions.description: Maps a raw database notification record to a Notification DTO with proper type casting
